stemMd: Why did the next trial adjust watering separately?

options.label: A
options.textMd: To investigate moisture effects without treating turning as the only relevant change.

options.label: B
options.textMd: To prove the first observation was fabricated.

options.label: C
options.textMd: To eliminate all differences between living systems forever.

options.label: D
options.textMd: To ensure that no temperature could be measured.

options.label: E
options.textMd: To replace all compost with dry soil.

explanationMd: Separate control of watering helps distinguish moisture loss from aeration effects associated with turning. The design follows the revised explanation that more than one condition influences the outcome.

distractorRationale.d: Temperature remained part of the records.
distractorRationale.b: The first observation was reinterpreted, not dismissed as false.
distractorRationale.c: The trial addresses a specific interaction.
